title: Implement template interpolation utility
description: Implement the template interpolation utility used by email templates and the export engine. Replaces {{variable}} tokens with values from a data object.
acceptanceCriteria: interpolate(template: string, data: Record<string, string>): string function exists
Replaces all {{key}} tokens with corresponding values from data
Handles nested keys with dot notation: {{business.name}}
Leaves unknown tokens unchanged (or replaces with empty string — configurable)
Handles array iteration: {{#each items}}...{{/each}} for repeating blocks

steps.details: Export `interpolate(template: string, data: Record<string, unknown>, options?: { keepUnknown?: boolean }): string`. Use regex replace for `{{key}}` tokens. Support dot notation by splitting on '.' and traversing the data object.
Use regex to find `{{#each arrayKey}}...{{/each}}` blocks. For each item in the array, repeat the inner template with array item data. Replace the entire block with the repeated output.
In src/lib/utils/__tests__/interpolate.test.ts: test simple replacement, dot notation, each blocks, missing keys. Run with `npm test`.
